implemented_requirements.evidence: Board class defines ROWS = 6, COLUMNS = 7 and builds a 6×7 list of lists in board.py.
Game class stores players in a list and switches turns with switch_turn(); current_player property used in the main loop (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players choose columns by typing a number
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.get_move prompts with safe_input and parses an integer (player.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate column choices (range and not full)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_valid_column checks 1‑based range and that the top cell is empty; Player.get_move calls this and repeats on invalid input (player.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Disc drops with gravity to the lowest empty cell
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.get_available_row scans from bottom up; Board.drop_disc places the disc at that row (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board updates after each move and is displayed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.play calls board.display() before each move and after a move is made (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lines of four
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.check_win iterates over four direction vectors and counts consecutive discs using _count_direction (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect draw when the grid is full
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_full returns True when every cell is occupied; Game.play ends the loop when this is true (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: End the game when a win or draw is detected
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.play breaks out of the loop after announcing the result when check_win or is_full is true (game.py).

judge.summary: All core Connect Four features are present and implemented with concrete code. The board, player interaction, win/draw detection, turn handling, and user‑friendly input handling are all provided. No major missing functionality or syntax errors are evident, making the solution likely to run correctly and satisfy the benchmark.
